title: Giving Thanks

readiness.reading: choosing and reading words to write a thank-you prayer

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Everyone is here: the neighbors, the travellers, and, look, even Sam from Bellhaven! Before we eat, we give thanks.

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Will you write our thank-you, for everyone to hear? Choose what you're most thankful for.

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Write the thank-you: choose a word for each coloured space.

outro.speaker: tobias
outro.text: Pass the bread, and the beans the child grew!

outro.speaker: ruth
outro.text: Sam, you came all this way! Look, here's the map you drew, and the friends who read it.

outro.speaker: amos
outro.text: To good work, good neighbors, and a good God!

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: My friend, look how much has grown since that first little letter. Thank you for everything.

journal_line: At the Harvest Supper, I wrote our thank-you, and we all ate together.
unavailable_text: The Harvest Supper is a happy memory.
